name: todo-api
description: Owns lists, list memberships, and tasks. Exposes CRUD for lists (create/delete, owner-only), collaborator invite/remove by username (owner-only), and task management (add/edit/complete/delete, sortable and filterable by due date and priority) for any list member. Resolves the caller's identity from the Thunder-validated token via the gateway-injected user header. Does not send email or push notifications, and does not handle sign-in itself.
